the application of LHF in conventional and organic farming technologies is an effective tool for improving the plant acclimation and development to low temperature stress during autumn.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

liquid humic fertilization during autumn acclimative period could be used as an alternative for conventional nitrogen fertilizers to enhance winter wheat biometric indices, namely LAI and root development, which are crucial for winter wheat adaptation to the low temperatures.
LHF application during autumn acclimatisation period could be used as a tool to increase w. wheat biometrical parameters.
LHF application to winter wheat seedlings during autumn acclimatisation period could be a promising tool to increase winter wheat productivity and quality in Lithuania.

LHF application in autumn acclimation period of winter wheat is effective in improving plant growth, LAI, and root system development.
